title: Copilot FinOps config (v3)
description: Schema for config/copilot-finops*.yml (version 3). v3 is budgets-first: it manages GitHub Copilot AI-credit budgets and drops the v2 ongoing per-member cost-center sync (there is no team_cost_center_mappings block). A budget's `scope` selects who it is for; `metered_credits_only` (boolean, default false) picks whether it caps the shared-pool + metered phase per user (the default) or only metered spend after the pool. There is NO `enterprise` field here — the enterprise slug is supplied only via the action's `enterprise` input, so real slugs never live in tracked config. This schema encodes shape, types, enums, typo protection (additionalProperties:false) and the per-scope required/forbidden field structure (including the metered_credits_only -> enforce gating). It targets JSON Schema draft 2020-12. Cardinality and uniqueness (at most one all_users / enterprise / organization budget, one budget per resolved cost center + metered_credits_only), plus every live lookup (cost center resolution, team membership) and value defaulting, stay in the semantic layer (src/config/validate.js) and the apply engine, not here.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: List of AI-credit budgets to apply. Optional — omit it (or use []) for a no-op config. Each entry maps to exactly one GitHub budget API call (some via a resolved cost center).

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: One AI-credit budget. `scope` is the primary selector; it controls which identity fields are required or forbidden, and (with metered_credits_only) whether `enforce` is allowed.

name.title: Budget name
name.description: Local label used in logs and the apply report. Never sent to the GitHub API (budgets have no name field).

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional human-readable description of what the budget is for.
examples: Default per-user AI-credit budget for every licensed user.

scope.title: Budget scope
scope.description: Who the budget is for. Maps (with metered_credits_only) to one of GitHub's official budget controls.

oneOf.title: All users
oneOf.description: Universal per-user budget for every licensed user (API multi_user_customer). Covers pool + metered; always hard-stop.

oneOf.title: User
oneOf.description: Individual per-user budget for each login in `users` (API user). Covers pool + metered; always hard-stop; overrides the universal and cost-center user-level budgets.

oneOf.title: Cost center
oneOf.description: Budget for a named cost center (`cost_center`). Default (metered_credits_only:false) = per-user pool+metered cap for every member (API multi_user_cost_center, hard-stop). metered_credits_only:true = collective metered cap for the cost center (API cost_center).

oneOf.title: Team
oneOf.description: Budget for an enterprise team (`team`), applied through the cost center that contains it (found, or created and the team assigned). Default = per-member pool+metered cap (multi_user_cost_center); metered_credits_only:true = the cost center's collective metered cap.

oneOf.title: Organization
oneOf.description: Budget for an organization (`organization`) — a direct cap on the org's collective metered spend after the shared pool (API organization). Use metered_credits_only: true (or omit it); the per-member path (metered_credits_only: false, a per-user ULB) is not yet supported — use all_users or scope: user for per-user coverage. Optional hard-stop via `enforce`.

oneOf.title: Enterprise
oneOf.description: One enterprise-wide budget capping collective metered spend after the shared pool (API enterprise). Optional hard-stop via `enforce`.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Budget cap in whole USD. Maps to budget_amount.

metered_credits_only.title: Metered credits only
metered_credits_only.description: false (default) caps the whole shared-pool + metered phase per user (a per-user hard-stop for the group); true caps only metered/additional spend after the pool (collective). Settable on cost_center and team, and on organization (where metered_credits_only: false — a per-member org budget — is currently gated as 'not yet supported' by the validator); fixed elsewhere (all_users/user always false; enterprise always metered) and forbidden there.

users.title: Users
users.description: GitHub logins to budget; each login gets its own hard-stop user budget. Required (one or more) for scope: user; forbidden on every other scope.

cost_center.title: Cost center
cost_center.description: Cost center name (resolved to its ID at apply time). Required for scope: cost_center; forbidden on every other scope.

team.title: Team
team.description: Enterprise team identifier. Prefer the bare slug (no ent: prefix), but apply also resolves the API slug (ent:<slug>) or display name to the canonical bare slug before assigning the team to a cost center. Required for scope: team; forbidden on every other scope. Resolved to the cost center that contains the team, or a cost center is created and the team assigned to it.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Organization login. Required for scope: organization; forbidden on every other scope. The budget is a direct collective metered cap for the org (no cost center, no member enumeration).

enforce.title: Enforce (hard stop)
enforce.description: Hard-stop usage at the cap (maps to prevent_further_usage). Allowed only on collective metered budgets (scope: enterprise or organization, or scope: cost_center/team with metered_credits_only: true); default true. Pool/per-user budgets are always hard-stop and forbid this field.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: GitHub logins to alert when the budget is hit. Optional; defaults to []. A non-empty list enables alerting.

allow_shared_cost_center.title: Allow shared cost center
allow_shared_cost_center.description: Opt in to budgeting a cost center that already holds resources beyond the target team. Only valid on scope: team. Default false: if the resolved cost center is shared, the budget is skipped and the blast radius is reported. When true, the whole cost center is budgeted.

allOf.$comment: scope: all_users — no identity fields; metered_credits_only, enforce, allow_shared_cost_center forbidden (always per-user hard-stop).
scope: user — requires users; forbids other identity fields and metered_credits_only/enforce/allow_shared_cost_center (always per-user hard-stop).
scope: enterprise — no identity fields, no metered_credits_only (fixed true), no allow_shared_cost_center. enforce is allowed (collective metered).
scope: cost_center — requires cost_center; forbids users/team/organization and allow_shared_cost_center (the cost center is named explicitly).
scope: team — requires team; forbids users/cost_center/organization.

scope: organization — requires organization; forbids users/cost_center/team and allow_shared_cost_center (no cost center). metered_credits_only is a plain boolean here (shape only); the per-member/per-user org path (metered_credits_only: false) is gated as 'not yet supported' by the semantic validator, not the schema. enforce is allowed.
enforce gating for cost_center: forbidden unless metered_credits_only is true (the pool/per-user path is always hard-stop).
enforce gating for team: forbidden unless metered_credits_only is true.
